name: Media Organizer 1.4.1
body:
**QA-hardened release.** A full automated QA cycle was run: 101 scenario checks covering input validation, hostile filenames (Turkish/Unicode/emoji/reserved names), corrupt files, locked files, flow abuse (cancel mid-run, double organize, undo twice), all 7 folder strategies, duplicates, a 2,000-file stress test, and settings persistence — 101/101 passing.

One real defect found and fixed: corrupted app settings could previously prevent the app from starting; it now starts safely.

Data-safety verified: no overwrite ever (collision suffixes), self-copy blocked, cancelled runs leave only complete files, undo restores exactly the partial set.

153 automated tests, all passing.

Download **MediaOrganizer-Setup-1.4.1.exe** below.
